sanskrit: pṛcchati sma mahādevī brūhi jñānaṃ maheśvarabrahmajñānaṃ kathaṃ deva sṛṣṭisaṃhāravarjitamavyaktaṃ brahmaṇo jñānaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhāra varjitammantra - pūjā - tapo - dhyānaṃ karmākarma tathaiva cadharmaśāstrapurāṇāni etā vidyāścaturdaśabrahmajñānaṃ padaṃ jñātvā sarvavidyā sthirā bhavetyā punaḥ śāmbhavī vidyā guptā kulavadhūrivadehasthāḥ sarvatīrthāni guruvākyena labhyatedharma karma tathā japyametat sarvaṃ nivartatedehamadhye tathā devaḥ puṇyapāpavivarjitaḥiḍāpiṅgalayormadhye suṣumnā ca sarasvatītatra snānaṃ prakurvīta sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyatekīdṛśyadhyātmavidyā ca tanme brūhi maheśvarasā eva mudrā vicarantī khecarīsā eva vidyā vicarantī śāmbhavīdarśanāni kathaṃ deva bhavanti ca pṛthak pṛthakprakṛtivādaratāḥ śāktā bauddhā śūnyātivādinaḥsarvaṃ nāstīti cārvākā jalpanti viṣayāśritāḥpañcabhūtaṃ kathaṃ deva guṇāḥ ke pañcaviṃśatiḥpṛthvī pañcaguṇā proktā brahmajñānena bhāsateapāṃ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsatetejaḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsatevāyoḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsatenabhaḥ pañcaguṇāḥ proktā brahmajñānena bhāsateraverutpadyate toyaṃ toyādutpadyate mahī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00191 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ravirvilīyate vāyau vāyurvilīyate tu khepañcatattvāt paraṃ tattvaṃ tattvātītaṃ nirañjanampañcendriyamidaṃ tattvaṃ manaḥ sādhakamindriyamsākārāśca vinaśyanti nirākāro na naśyatitasmāt sarvaprayatnena sākāraṃ tu parityajetātmā caivāntarātmā ca paramātmā kathaṃ bhavetasti tvak caiva saptaite śarīreṣu vyavasthitāḥparamātmā bhavecchūnyaṃ mano yatra vilīyateśūnyadhāturbhavet prāṇo garbhapiṇḍaṃ prajāyatevākyasya nirṇayaṃ brūhi paśya jñānamudāharamanasotpadyate vācā mano vācā vilīyatekasmin sthāne vased vāyuḥ kasmin sthāne vasenmanaḥsūryāgre vasate vāyuścandrāgre vasate manaḥetadyuktaṃ mahādevi guruvākyena labhyatekasmin sthāne vaset kālo jarā kena prajāyateantarikṣe vaset kālo jarā tena prajāyatejāgrat svapnasuṣuptau ca ko vā'sau pratibudhyatijāgratsvapnasuṣuptau ca vāyuśca pratibudhyatiko vā karoti pāpāni ko vā pāpaiḥ pramucyatemanaśca tanmanā bhūtvā na puṇyairna ca pātakaiḥkāryasya kāraṇaṃ brūhi kathaṃ kiñca prasādanamkāryaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ tvañca punarbodho viśiṣyateidaṃ tīrthamidaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramanti tāmasā janāḥbrahmavidyārato yastu sa vipro vedapāragaḥsāraṃ tu yogibhiḥ pītaṃ takraṃ pibanti paṇḍitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00191 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nocchiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo jñānamavyaktaṃ cetanāmayamūrdhvaretā bhaved yastu sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥtasya dhyānaprasādena saukhyaṃ mokṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥbrahmāgnau hūyate prāṇaṃ homakarma taducyatetasmāt sarvaprayatnena tādrūpyaṃ ca tyajed budhaḥbrahmajñānapadaṃ jñātvā sarvavarṇavivarjitaḥniścayaṃ brūhi deveśa mano yatra vilīyatevinā svapnaṃ yathā nidrā brahmajñānaṃ taducyatebālabhāvastathā bhāvo brahmajñānaṃ taducyatesarvacintāparityāgo niścinto yoga ucyateśatajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyatietanme brūhi bho deva paścājjñānaṃ prakāśayaekaviṃśatibrahmāṇḍaṃ saptapātālameva camadhyaśaktirbhavennābhiḥ śaktyatītaṃ nirañjanamcakrabhedaṃ mayākhyātaṃ cakrātītaṃ namo namaḥūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhaṃ vṛkṣākāraṃ kalevaramdaśavāyuḥ kathaṃ deva daśadvārāṇi caiva hisamāno nābhideśe tu udānaḥ kaṇṭhamāśritaḥnāga ūrdhvagato vāyuḥ kūrmastīrthāni saṃsthitaḥdhanañjayo nādaghoṣe niviśeccaiva śāmyatinavadvāraṃ ca prātyakṣaṃ daśamaṃ mana ucyateśaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī caiva prasūtā daśanāḍikāgāndhārī hastijihvā ca prasavā gamanāyatākulaśca śaṅkhinī caiva vāmāṅge ca vyavasthitāḥdvisaptatisahasrāṇi śarīre nāḍikāḥ smṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00191 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānanāḍī bhaveddevī yogināṃ siddhidāyinītrayo devā kathaṃ deva trayo bhāvāstrayo guṇāḥkrodhabhāvasthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥnānābhāvaṃ mano yasya tasya muktirna jāyatemanorūpaḥ sthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥagnibhāvasthito rudrastrayo devāstrayo guṇāḥnānābhāvaṃ mano yasya tasya muktirna jāyateahaṃ rudro'pyahaṃ śūnyamahaṃ vyāpī nirañjanamsvabhāvanirmalaṃ svāntaṃ sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥsatyavādī bhaved bhakto dātā dhīro hiterataḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena dayādharmaṃ samāśrayetvedasandhyā tapo dhyānaṃ homakarma kulaṃ kathambrahmajñānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīmbrahmajñānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīmna svāmī ca gurostulyaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ padamgurostulyaṃ na vai ko'pi yaddṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ padampṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā cānṛṇī bhavetyasya kasyāpi bhaktasya sadgurustasya dīyatesaṃnyāsaṃ sarvakarmāṇi laukikāni tyajed budhaḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena yatiḥ saṅgaṃ parityajetmakārastāmasaḥ proktastribhiḥ prakṛtirucyateīśvarānnirgatā sā hi prakṛtirguṇabandhanāavidyā mohinī yā sā śabdarūpā yaśasvinīmakāraḥ sāmavedastu triṣu yukto'pyatharvaṇaḥakārastvatha bhūrloka ukāro bhuva ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00191 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akṣaraistribhiretaiśca bhavedātmā vyavasthitaḥantarīkṣaṃ ukārastu vidyudvarṇa ihocyatedhruvamekākṣaraṃ brahma oṃ ityevaṃ vyavasthitamāsu sa jāyate yogī nānyathā śivabhāṣitamsarvapāpaviśuddhātmā śivalokaṃ sa gacchatiparamārthaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ sthūlasūkṣmasya lakṣaṇamsthūlarūpī sthito'yaṃ ca sūkṣmaśca anyathā sthitaḥ
